reason: It sounds sensible and the free CA call helps, but I have never heard of REPAIHUB and this is my flat money, so I would not hand it to a new company on a first look. My instinct is still to sort it out on my next India trip or through my own CA.
objection: I don't know if I can trust a company I just found with a six-figure property sale. If the TDS or T1135 side goes wrong, I carry the risk, not them. Their CA is also not my CA.
would_change_my_mind: My own CA or a friend who has used them confirms it works, and the TDS and Form 145/146 handling for a flat sale is explained clearly, ideally with a few real customer reviews.
